title: First genus of substantial composition: genus and difference — rejected
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Ye FIRST genus belonging toward substantial composition that from genus plus difference distinguished is. Every true genus univocal is. But no common genus for God with ye other things there is, nor a difference properly so called. God unto some predicament or genus restricted cannot be, but above all genera plus outside them is. Unto this first genus belonging toward composition also composition from essence plus existence we have reduced.
pass_b_english: The FIRST genus of substantial composition is that distinguished from genus and difference. Every true genus is univocal. But there is no common genus for God with the other things, nor a difference properly so called. God cannot be restricted to some predicament or genus, but is above all genera and outside them. To this first genus of composition we have also reduced composition from essence and existence.
source_text: PRIMUM substantialis compositionis genus, distinctum ex genere & differentia. Omne verum genus est univocum. Atqui nullum commune genus Deo cum rebus caeteris, neque differentia proprie dicta. Deus non potest restringi ad aliquod praedicamentum seu genus, sed supra omnia genera & extra ea est. Ad hoc primum genus compositionis reduximus quoque compositionem ex essentia & exsistentia.
